purpose: Starter structure for maps, charts, timelines, Christ connections, spiritual-being studies, and presentation-ready teaching visuals. This file records public-domain or locally-owned source paths first; it does not import copyrighted map art or modern chart content.
rights_policy: Use KJV references and internally created summaries. Do not copy modern study Bible charts, copyrighted maps, copyrighted images, or copyrighted sermon outlines. Public-domain images still require source and rights metadata before being shown publicly.
